test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On: 2 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: 6 men or 2 women or 4 boys can finish a work in 77 days. How many days will 1 man, 1 woman, and 1 boy together take to finish the same work?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**6 men or 2 women or 4 boys can complete work in 77 days means,

We can get total work out of any one,

Total work = total number of days × total number of men 

⇒ 77 × 6 = 462

Then, efficiency of each men

⇒ 462/6x = 77 = 1

Efficiency of each women 

⇒ 462/2x = 77 = 3

Efficiency of each boy

⇒ 462/4x = 77 = 1.5

Total work done by 1 men, 1 women, & 1 boy 

⇒ 462/(1 + 3 + 1.5) =** 84 days**
